takeaways: Custom connectors create compounding integration debt, while one governed MCP server per domain can serve many AI clients with the same security model and audit trail.
Classic DLP policies and audit logs do not yet see MCP servers or agent actions clearly, so advanced connector policies, Entra agent identities and interim controls such as approval workflows matter.
Clean, business-readable Dataverse metadata and a governance-first design are prerequisites for MCP, because AI agents only understand what the schema and descriptions tell them.
hook: Every new AI tool still triggers another custom connector, and the maintenance and security debt keeps growing. This episode is for Power Platform architects, integration engineers and IT leaders who want to understand how Dataverse MCP changes enterprise integration. You learn where MCP saves time and tokens, where governance and security gaps remain, and how to plan a realistic migration.
